title: Germany news: Police probe security incident at Leipzig/Halle airport
summary: A fence breach at the Leipzig/Halle airport has triggered a major police operation. Christian Social Union leader Markus Söder is to address a gathering of the conservative youth wing. Follow DW for…

image.caption: The incident at Leipzig airport comes weeks after an explosives-laden drone was found thereImage: Tobias Junghannß/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: Police investigate breach of fence at Leipzig/Halle airport

blocks.caption: The damage to the fence was discovered late on Saturday eveningImage: Erik-Holm Langhof/EHL Media/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: Police probing an overnight incident in which a fence was breached at the Leipzig/Halle airport say the damage was most likely caused by a vehicle crashing through the barrier.

A police spokesman told the DPA news agency on Sunday that the damaged section was close to three Russian Antonov cargo planes that have been grounded at the airport since 2022 because of EU sanctions on Moscow over its invasion of Ukraine.
Police said they had searched the site, but didn't find any unauthorized people on the premises, with search measures set to continue throughout the day.
An airport spokesman said air traffic had been unaffected by the police operation, as only one of two available runways had been closed.
The airport made the news in August after an explosives-laden drone was found near Ukrainian cargo planes at the facility.
That incident was blamed by German officials on Russia, which has denied involvement.
